reviewLead.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness review these sessions

1 long-session candidate still need outcome review

## Evidence to inspect

- S1: user-thread candidate, about 157.6 estimated active minutes, 61 failure event(s)

## First step

Create <run> in the OS temporary directory, then run from the project root:

```bash
node scripts/session-analysis.mjs insights --platform codex --workspace . --selection all-eligible --limit 1000 --format json --output <run>/insights.json
node scripts/session-analysis/usage-review-packet.mjs --source <run>/insights.json --workspace . --limit 8 --output <run>/.review-packet.json
```

The private review packet resolves candidates locally. Write taskFamily, outcome, friction, confidence, and evidenceReason only for S1. Finish diagnosis before editing product code or creating a Memory, Skill, or Hook.

## What we saw

1 of 2 analyzed sessions (50.0%) crossed the estimated active-time threshold; the longest estimate was 157.6 minutes and 0 have reviewed outcomes. 0 additional long spans may be idle or resumed work. This is an investigation lead, not a confirmed efficiency, decomposition, tool, or model problem.

## Why review it

Without outcome review, complex work, tool friction, idle/resume noise, and a normal long task remain indistinguishable.

## Expected result

Each displayed candidate is classified by task family, outcome, and friction so the report can decide whether any real improvement is needed.

## Scope

Create only a privacy-safe session-efficiency review and reader report. Do not edit product code or treat wall span as active cost. Durable reports keep aliases only; do not copy the private review packet into them. This is the complete 1/1 candidate view; conclusions still require semantic review.

## Done when

<run>/.review.json has one valid row for each of S1; semantic review writes <run>/insights.reviewed.json; and <run>/report.md validates against the reviewed source. If review confirms no problem, do not create an improvement.

## Validation

- Run `node scripts/session-analysis/usage-semantic-review.mjs --source <run>/insights.json --packet <run>/.review-packet.json --review <run>/.review.json --output <run>/insights.reviewed.json`
- Run `node scripts/session-analysis/validate-usage-report.mjs --source <run>/insights.reviewed.json --report <run>/report.md`; it must return `ok: true`
- Confirm `outcomeReview.reviewedActiveLongCount` in the reviewed source equals the number of reviewed displayed aliases; delete the two private review files after validation
